scope: Seated 2025-2026 Pennsylvania General Assembly roster as shown on the official member pages, with one representative-elect annotation; county coverage reflects legislative districts, not a claim that every county resident has every listed member.
notes: A county can contain parts of several House and Senate districts. Use a street address and the General Assembly Find My Legislator tool for an individual voter.
The roster pages identify members for the 2025-2026 session. November 2026 election winners are not assumed seated before the next term.

District 98 Tom Jones is also labeled Representative-elect on the House roster; he appears in current-session legislative records. The public label is preserved rather than inferring a different current officeholder.
